title: OpenAI Secret API key: must be flagged
summary: Synthetic OpenAI Secret API key values built to the documented format appear in 9 inputs. Each input records the exact byte range of the secret.
rationale: A credential that a scanner misses in an ordinary carrier is leaked. Carriers differ in quoting, delimiters and surrounding text, so a hit on one carrier does not show coverage of another.

expectation.rationale: Legacy prefix-plus-random-body does not meet the reviewed length, alphabet or internal structure. Historical positive expectation retained only as a regression.
